rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in AA features; the ICM and TE look less clearly pristine/cohesive on this single image than described.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, male factor, partner age, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate emphasis on maternal age and aneuploidy risk; only minor overinterpretation of morphology and probability precision.
Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET preference and caution about add-ons; minor speculative protocol comments prevent a perfect score.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and future evaluation options, though some advice remains somewhat general.
